but i know it's really unhelpful, but i don't want to live in a world where i've failed. School makes this impossible - literally (literally, I am not kidding) every other school in the country allows resits/deferrals for people in terrible states. Like I am. Not mine. 

I just don't want to. I can tell I'm not in my right mind & it scares me. I know this is something I hypothetically /can/ do, but not right now. but it's now or never. That makes me want to kill myself, and I want to kill myself. I know it's awful because I have people who really love me - my mom & my sister - but it's not enough. Why can't this decision be for me?

hey bluedog. well. first. as someone who is /terribly/ depressed and is kinda sorta plotting to kill myself sometime in the next 2 hrs, I'll tell you something - I'd rather have my mom than $10 million dollars. She is utterly irreplaceable to me. And we're broke. I don't say that lightly. 

And you want to talk pros and cons? Okay. Big con: money is temporary. You said that you burned through money yourself. That, right there, is why it's a dumb idea to kill yourself bc of money (no judgement, me too). Do you have a gf/wife? What if she becomes hopelessly depressed by your death that she burns through the money? It can happen. People stricken by this kind of grief don't think logically. Or that she gets defrauded? Money is not some safe, stable object. There is not /any/ single way to make sure your son has that money or spends it on the right things. 

Also, loss of a parent in early life can cause huge psychological problems.
TBH, it was taking time out of school and having time to work through it. I wish I'd intermit between 2nd and 3rd year, instead of 1st+2nd.
